files_or_snippet: src/token-stream.js (acquired via browser: Raw -> select all -> copy -> paste to src/reference/token-stream.js; reference copy deleted after adaptation)
how_adapted: Adapted ideas and logic only: decimal number scanning with an exponent that is not consumed when it has no digits (isNumber), radix integer scanning (isRadixInteger), identifier scanning (isName/isNamedOp), and token position recording used for SyntaxError positions. Rewritten to the calc-s2 token shape ({t,v,p}), with the unknown-character token reported lazily by the parser, plus a 0x/0b prefix limited to lowercase per spec. The upstream parser, expression tree, evaluator, and the upstream getCoordinates/line:column error format were not used. Upstream comments/code text were not copied verbatim.
